plugins.name: no-human
plugins.description: File a task with no_human and check on it without leaving Claude Code: task_add and task_status over your local no_human server (127.0.0.1:8420). no_human plans, codes, tests and has the work reviewed by a second model, then opens the pull request and stops. Also ships nh gate: run the fresh-session reviewer and tamper guard over your current branch or a GitHub pull request, no server required.
